actor_cost_definition: Historical actor accounting preserved; fresh gap repairs use native charged_or_reserved actor USD excluding Terra. Saved-actor first-Terra recoveries reuse original actor metrics.
comparison_caveat: Original valid successes and failures are preserved; only frozen previously invalid or missing cells receive one new outcome. Common-valid conditioning and asynchronous live collection windows limit causal comparisons. Failed repairs remain invalid. Cached reruns and new Sol60 are separate.
prompt_limit_caveat: Historical 60-decision single enforced 60 but advertised 30; new single120 enforces and advertises 120. Live windows and validity subsets differ.
browser_command_definition: One selected nonempty browser-code batch per decision; a batch may contain multiple browser/CDP calls. Unselected candidate batches and selection calls do not count.
